Who is Gerudo Thief?

In , encounters in the prison chambers of the . They guard the cells holding the four captive , with one guarding each cell. They shortly reveal themselves as speaks with each .

Once defeated, the will retreat, never to appear again. They leave behind a to their 's cell. After all four are defeated and every rescued, a will appear and commend on his abilities, inviting him into the 's territory.
